## Gemini 3.8 Flash API

Gemini 3.8 Flash is a large language model by Google, available on the Venice API as `gemini-3-8-flash`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Gemini 3.8 Flash, the successor to Gemini 3.7 Flash, is built for complex coding, agentic workflows, and reliable multi-step execution, with 1M context and tunable thinking.

### Gemini 3.8 Flash API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gemini-3-8-flash` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.9375 / $4.69 per 1M |

### Gemini 3.8 Flash specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Google |
| Released | Sep 2, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 64K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |

### How to use the Gemini 3.8 Flash API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "gemini-3-8-flash"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-3-8-flash",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
